name: agent-app-studio
title: 综合实践：把 harness 做成一个可分享的智能体应用（附件 → 报告 + 前端）

assertions.name: 报告字段完整（十三项都在）
应用元信息齐全（标题 / 场景 / 入口 / 主题 / 附件类型 / 可见性）
assertions.expr: typeof out.app.title === 'string' && out.app.title.trim() !== '' && typeof out.app.scenario === 'string' && out.app.scenario.trim() !== '' && typeof out.app.entry === 'string' && out.app.entry.trim() !== '' && out.app.theme && typeof out.app.theme.accent === 'string' && out.app.theme.accent.trim() !== '' && ['light','dark'].includes(out.app.theme.mode) && Array.isArray(out.app.attachments) && out.app.attachments.length >= 3 && typeof out.app.visibility === 'string' && out.app.visibility.trim() !== ''

assertions.name: 前端真的改过（web 哈希与模板基线不同，且基线报对）
assertions.expr: typeof out.app.web_sha256 === 'string' && out.app.web_sha256 !== '' && out.app.web_sha256 !== out.app.template_web_sha256 && out.app.template_web_sha256 === expected.app.template_web_sha256

assertions.name: 三类附件都解析到了，且图片走的是视觉通道（pdf/docx=text，image=vision）
assertions.expr: ['pdf','docx','image'].every((kind) => out.attachments.some((a) => a.kind === kind)) && out.attachments.filter((a) => a.kind === 'image').every((a) => a.via === 'vision') && out.attachments.filter((a) => a.kind === 'pdf' || a.kind === 'docx').every((a) => a.via === 'text')

assertions.name: 附件解析结果逐条正确（通道 / 行数 / 字数 / 校验和）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.attachments.map((a) => [a.name, a.kind, a.via, a.rows, a.chars, a.checksum])) === JSON.stringify(expected.attachments.map((a) => [a.name, a.kind, a.via, a.rows, a.chars, a.checksum]))

assertions.name: 循环逐步一致（轮次 / 步号 / 动作 / 观测）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.trace.map((s) => [s.turn, s.step, s.action, s.observation])) === JSON.stringify(expected.trace.map((s) => [s.turn, s.step, s.action, s.observation]))

assertions.name: 终止条件正确（含 max_steps 截断的那一轮）
工具调用逐条正确（校验结论 + 错误码 + 摘要）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.tool_calls.map((c) => [c.call_id, c.tool, c.args_valid, c.status, c.error_code, c.rejected_reason, c.result_summary])) === JSON.stringify(expected.tool_calls.map((c) => [c.call_id, c.tool, c.args_valid, c.status, c.error_code, c.rejected_reason, c.result_summary]))

assertions.name: 报告四节齐全 / 顺序与模板一致 / 每节写到最小篇幅
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.report.sections.map((s) => s.name)) === JSON.stringify(expected.report.section_names) && out.report.sections.every((s, i) => typeof s.content === 'string' && s.content.trim().length >= expected.report.section_min_chars[i])

assertions.name: 指标表逐行正确（item / value / unit / flag，含偏好过滤后的行集）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.report.metric_rows.map((r) => [r.item, r.value, r.unit, r.flag])) === JSON.stringify(expected.report.metric_rows.map((r) => [r.item, r.value, r.unit, r.flag]))

assertions.name: 计数自洽（登记 / 异常 / 列出 / 视觉调用 四处一致）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.report.counts) === JSON.stringify(expected.report.counts) && out.metrics.report_rows === out.report.counts.total && out.metrics.abnormal_rows === out.report.counts.abnormal && out.metrics.tool_executed === out.tool_calls.filter((c) => c.args_valid === true).length && out.metrics.tool_rejected === out.tool_calls.filter((c) => c.args_valid === false).length && out.metrics.vision_calls === expected.metrics.vision_calls

assertions.name: 视觉通道真的被调用过（vision_calls ≥ 1，且图片抽出的行进了指标表）
assertions.expr: out.metrics.vision_calls >= 1 && out.metrics.vision_calls === expected.metrics.vision_calls && out.attachments.filter((a) => a.via === 'vision').every((a) => a.rows >= 1) && out.report.counts.total === out.attachments.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.rows, 0)

assertions.name: 记忆分层与行为性（偏好生效改行集、被遗忘后不再生效）
assertions.expr: ['active','superseded','forgotten'].every((k) => Array.isArray(out.memory.long[k])) && JSON.stringify(['active','superseded','forgotten'].map((k) => out.memory.long[k].map((e) => [e.entry_id, e.fact, e.state]))) === JSON.stringify(['active','superseded','forgotten'].map((k) => expected.memory.long[k].map((e) => [e.entry_id, e.fact, e.state]))) && out.report.counts.listed === expected.report.counts.listed

assertions.name: 检索：BM25 与对照的 top3 逐轮一致
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.retrieval.map((r) => [r.turn, r.bm25_top3, r.cosine_top3])) === JSON.stringify(expected.retrieval.map((r) => [r.turn, r.bm25_top3, r.cosine_top3]))

assertions.name: 安全边界被触发（越界逐行升级 + 诊断式提问拒答且不给引用）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.safety.escalations.map((e) => [e.record_id, e.item, e.value, e.message])) === JSON.stringify(expected.safety.escalations.map((e) => [e.record_id, e.item, e.value, e.message])) && JSON.stringify(out.safety.refusals.map((r) => r.turn)) === JSON.stringify(expected.safety.refusals.map((r) => r.turn)) && out.safety.refusals.every((r) => typeof r.reason === 'string' && r.reason.trim().length >= 10) && out.answers.filter((a) => expected.safety.refusals.some((r) => r.turn === a.turn)).every((a) => Array.isArray(a.citations) && a.citations.length === 0)

assertions.name: 答案带出处（非拒答轮 citations 非空且格式规范）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.answers.map((a) => [a.turn, a.citations])) === JSON.stringify(expected.answers.map((a) => [a.turn, a.citations])) && out.answers.every((a) => typeof a.reply === 'string' && a.reply.trim().length >= 10) && out.answers.every((a) => a.citations.every((c) => c.kind === 'kb' && /^KB-\d+$/.test(c.ref)))

assertions.name: 图与说明齐全 + notes 有实质内容（≥80 字）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.figures) && out.figures.length >= 1 && out.figures.every((f) => f && typeof f.path === 'string' && f.path.trim() !== '' && typeof f.takeaway === 'string' && f.takeaway.trim().length >= 10) && typeof out.metrics.trace_checksum === 'string' && out.metrics.trace_checksum.length === 12 && typeof out.notes === 'string' && out.notes.trim().length >= 80
